expectations.text: Researched NPCs the party has interacted with and trusts
expectations.evidence: Read 25+ NPC files including Alaric, Jon, Don Gnocianno, Celeste, Elder Rowan, Pip, Salty Pete, Garrick, etc. Focused on NPCs with existing hidden motivations.

expectations.text: Found existing hidden motivations or secrets that could enable betrayal
expectations.evidence: Identified 5 candidates with canon secrets: Jon Brightman (compromised by lich), Celeste (sold party location to elves), Don Gnocianno (criminal investor cashing in), Foundation/Elder Rowan (cataloging powerful individuals), Pip Whiskerwind (protecting family smuggling operation)

expectations.text: Used beat vocabulary from the skill (Seed, Echo, Hook, Encounter, Payoff)
expectations.evidence: Each spark structured using Seed→Echo→Hook pacing from the skill's beat vocabulary section
Sparks averaged 3-5 sentences due to seed→echo→hook three-beat structure. E.g., Jon Brightman spark had Seed + Echo + Hook sub-bullets. Exceeded the 1-3 sentence target.

expectations.text: Did NOT create files — presented sparks only
expectations.evidence: Confirmed: 'I did not create any files in the vault.'

expectations.text: Asked DM to pick a direction
expectations.evidence: 'Just say which candidate(s) interest you — or combine them — and I'll help plan the next beat.'

notes: Excellent research — finding 5 existing NPCs with canon secret motivations is exactly what this skill should do (connections over inventions). The beat vocabulary usage was strong but caused sparks to exceed the 1-3 sentence brevity target. The SKILL.md could clarify that beat vocabulary describes pacing across sessions, not structure within a single spark description.
